title: Quick Connect Toolbar always disables itself after closing the application
author: RyanNHS
body_snippet:
Using the stable version and the latest nightly build. 

When opening the application for the first time after install, the quick connect toolbar is there. After when closing the application, the toolbar will be disabled and must be enabled manually and after that it will be disabled every time the application is closed so must be enabled each startup

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Fixed for the next nightly build (≥ tonight).

**Cause:** the toolbar visibility is saved at shutdown, but `SaveSettings` runs *after* the main window has already been hidden (it's invoked from the shutdown cleanup, and the `Close to Tray` exit path hides even earlier). A hidden parent makes `Control.Visible` report `false` for every child, so the Quick Connect toolbar was persisted as hidden on **every** exit and came back hidden on the next launch — exactly the "must enable on every startup" b...
